Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.mfa

Class FindTrustedDeviceUseCase

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.mfa.FindTrustedDeviceUseCase
@Service @Transactional(readOnly=true) public class FindTrustedDeviceUseCase extends Object
Use case that finds the usable (not revoked, not expired) trusted device of a user from the value of the cookie. The signature of the value is checked first, in constant time: a forged or unsigned value is rejected before the account or the device is looked up.
